_comment: Manual mapping of Google Sheets names to Discord User IDs
_instructions: Use this ONLY when members' Discord names are completely different from Google Sheets names
If member is not in Discord anymore, either:
1. Remove them from Google Sheets, OR
2. Leave empty here - they'll stay with temp IDs until they interact
How to get Discord User ID:
1. Enable Developer Mode in Discord (User Settings → Advanced → Developer Mode)
2. Right-click the user's name anywhere in Discord
